svg.title: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 pinout for the ZYC0049 robot (BalancingRobotTunerESP32S3)
svg.text: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8 as used by BalancingRobotTunerESP32S3 · numbers are GPIOs · 3.3 V logic, not 5 V tolerant
Header order from Espressif's DevKitC-1 guide (pin 1 at the antenna end); check it against your board's silkscreen before wiring.
